verdict.rationale: The SDK lives in a public GitHub repository (runanywhere-sdks). Community reports say the RCLI component is MIT-licensed and that users file bug reports, so outside contribution is plausible. The core inference engine (MetalRT) is reportedly proprietary, and nothing documents how contributions are accepted or how contributors are recognized. Missing for 10: CONTRIBUTING guidelines or a documented PR/review process, contributor or maintainer recognition, clarity on which components accept outside code, and corroboration of external contributions being merged.
